blocks.source: 伴奏ができたので、ベースを作ります。ちなみにベースというのは英語。ドイツ語ではバスだそうです。
blocks.translation: Now that the accompaniment is finished, I'll create the bass. Incidentally, “bass” is the English term; apparently, it’s called “Bass” in German.

blocks.source: トラックは『CH03』で。別に04でも05でもいいですけどね。
blocks.translation: Use the “CH03” track. Though 04 or 05 would work just as well.

blocks.source: 楽器番号33～40にあるBassとかBsと書いてあるヤツがベースです。僕の場合『035:Picked Bs.』あたりをよく使ってます。
blocks.translation: The instruments numbered 33–40 with “Bass” or “Bs” in their names are bass instruments. In my case, I often use something around “035:Picked Bs.”

blocks.source: ベースとは低音域を担当する楽器のことです。実態はバイオリンやコントラバス、ギターといった弦楽器を低音で鳴らしているんだそうで。当然、主旋律や伴奏よりも低音になります。
blocks.translation: The bass is an instrument responsible for the low range. Apparently, it is essentially a string instrument such as a violin, double bass, or guitar played in a low register. Naturally, its notes are lower than those of the melody or accompaniment.

blocks.source: 低音になりますが、使用する音階は同じで「高いラ」から「低いラ」になるだけです。イヤホンを付けておかないと、聞き取りにくいかもしれません。必要なら装着をば。
blocks.translation: Although it is in a low register, it uses the same scale, simply going from “high A” to “low A.” It may be difficult to hear unless you have earphones on, so put them on if necessary.

blocks.source: では、最初の１６小節を打ち込んでみましょう。
blocks.translation: Now, let's enter the first 16 measures.

blocks.source: やはり、主旋律や伴奏と大きく不協和音を起こさないように打ち込みます。といっても、もう伴奏に沿っていくだけでもよいと思います。
blocks.translation: As before, enter the notes so they do not create significant dissonance with the melody or accompaniment. That said, I think it is fine simply to follow the accompaniment at this point.

blocks.source: 伴奏が「ドファラ」の和音ならド。「シミソ」ならシ――というように、伴奏の一番低い音に合わせてみました。１６小節全部この調子なので、キャプチャーはいりませんよね。
blocks.translation: When the accompaniment chord is “C-F-A,” I used C; when it is “B-E-G,” I used B—and so on, matching the lowest note of the accompaniment. Since all 16 measures follow this pattern, we don't need a screenshot, do we?

blocks.source: もっとも、別にここまできっちり合わせる必要はないです。もう少し独自性を主張してもよいと思います。……が、面倒ならこれでもよいです。
blocks.translation: That said, there is no need to match it this precisely. I think you could assert a little more individuality. …But if you can't be bothered, this is fine too.

blocks.source: 次に後ろの１６小節です。伴奏と同じくサビでは構成を変えてみましょう。
blocks.translation: Next are the last 16 measures. As with the accompaniment, let's change the arrangement during the chorus.

blocks.source: 音符の数が二倍になっています。盛り上がるところのベースは音符をたくさん打ったほうがそれっぽいかなと。今度の場合、音階は伴奏の一番高い音に合わせてみました。そのほうが何となくしっくりきたので。
blocks.translation: There are twice as many notes. I figured that playing lots of notes for the bass in the exciting sections would make it feel more appropriate. This time, I matched the scale to the highest note in the accompaniment. It somehow sounded more natural that way.

blocks.source: はい。ベースがアッという間にできました！ もちろん、もっときちんと作る方法もありますが、それはまた後です。目指すは「誰にでも簡単に作れる作曲術」なので、とりあえずこれで行きましょう。
blocks.translation: There! The bass was finished in no time! Of course, there are ways to create it more properly, but we'll get to that later. Since our goal is “a composition method anyone can use easily,” let's go with this for now.

blocks.source: いい感じですね。ベースがあると安定感があります。
blocks.translation: Sounds good. Having a bass gives it a sense of stability.
